text:
Elena (CFO): Heads-up: new vendor approval & tax-withholding guidance rolling out next week. Two big changes: 1) Vendors classified as international contractors may require tax-withholding documentation; 2) a vendor approval matrix (Quick/Standard/High-touch) will determine PO thresholds and approval path. Full memo here: https://intra.redwood.com/finance/vendor-matrix :memo:

Noah (Finance Ops): Summary of the matrix: 
- Quick: pre-approved SaaS, PO optional up to $3k.
- Standard: recurring SaaS or hardware, PO required >= $3k.
- High-touch: vendors with data access or infra control, PO required for any amount + dual approval.
(Procurement will tag vendors on the new matrix.)

Ivy (Procurement): Practicals: starting Mon we ask all requesters to select vendor tier on the vendor-onboard form. If you don't know the tier, pick Standard and Procurement will triage. New vendor onboarding link: https://intra.redwood.com/forms/vendor-onboard :link:

TaxBot: SYSTEM: New rule: international contractor invoices may be subject to 10% withholding unless a W8-BEN or similar is on file. AP will request tax docs when vendor country != US. Vendors without docs may be paused.

Sam (Eng): Quick Q: we use several EU-based bench vendors for infra testing that bill monthly ~€1,800. Do they become High-touch because they're on infra?

Ivy (Procurement): If vendor needs network access or credentials, High-touch. If it's just remote SaaS UI, Standard. For infra-facing POCs, include a security contact and expected duration in the request and we can fast-track a limited PO.

Priya (Sales): What about reseller partners we pre-pay for trial credits? Those often include cross-border billing. Any special flow?

Noah (Finance Ops): If reseller is non-US and we prepay > $5k, add "tax-check" and "reseller" tags so AP knows to request withholding docs. Sales Ops can request a consolidated PO for a campaign to avoid many small invoices.

Rae (Legal): Legal reminder: any vendor contract that includes data processing or model hosting requires a Data Processing Addendum and Legal signature before Procurement issues a PO. Use Contract Intake and tag "DPA required". No vendor onboarding is complete without Legal's go-ahead for DPAs.

Sam (Eng): Noted. For short-term infra access we usually need credentials for 30 days. How do we capture that in request?

Ivy (Procurement): Use the onboarding form field "access_scope" and set expiry. Procurement will add that to the PO and security will follow up. POs for High-touch will include an explicit access expiry.

TaxBot: SYSTEM: Action needed: vendors outside US without tax docs will be emailed with instructions. Requesters should cc finance@redwood.com when engaging to speed processing.

Elena (CFO): TL;DR: vendor matrix sets tiers and PO rules; international contractors may need withholding docs; high-touch vendors require Legal + Procurement approvals at any size; use the forms and tag requests. Procurement will host two office hours next Tue/Wed 11am PT to walk teams through examples. Thanks all!
